Final for Publication

17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans — 1807-09 West Augusta Boulevard, Chicago, IL
Proposed Zoning: § RM-4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District
Lot Area: 4,819.2 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is proposing to redevelop the subject property with a new
three-story residential building containing six (6) dwelling units and a
detached garage. The proposed building will measure 36 ft.-3.5 in. in
height. The subject property is a Transit Served Location and will be
supported by five (5) off-street garage parking spaces. Pursuant to Sec. 17-
13-0303-D optional Administrative Adjustment and Variation and pursuant
to Secs. 17-13-1003-EE, 17-13-1003-K, and 17-13-1101-B of the Chicago
Zoning Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking to increase the off-street
parking ratio for a Transit Served Location to 83.33% (five (5) parking
spaces for six (6) residential units), waive the rear yard open space
requirement, reduce the front setback from 15 feet to 6 ft.-8 in., reduce the
total combined side setback to 6 ft., reduce the rear setback from 30.12 ft.
to 21 ft.-4 in., and is seeking all zoning relief, as needed and as allowed by
the Chicago Zoning Code, for the attached plans.

(A) _ The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 8,192.64 square feet (1.7 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 803.2 square feet per D.U.
(6 residential units)

(C) *The amount of off-street parking: 5 parking spaces

*The subject property is a designated Transit Served Location (Chicago Bus
Route). Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1003-EE, the Applicant is seeking to increase the
required number of off-street parking spaces from three (3) parking spaces (50%)
to five (5) parking spaces (83.33%).
